plate_comment: Returns the J1939 control device of a source address, the e2m Jcomm_Engine_Control_Device_Indicator / Jcomm_Retarder_Control_Device_Indicator code: 1 when it is j1939_transmission_source_address, 2 for j1939_anti_lock_brake_source_address, 3 for j1939_anti_slip_regulation_source_address, else 4 (0 = none is the reset value) (was cm848_lookupJ1939SourceAddressIndex)
